caption: The drawing features a square composition with a grid-like pattern in blue and off-white colors. The central section contains a series of wavy, horizontal blue lines forming undulating geometric patterns that alternate with straight, vertical and horizontal segments. In each of the four corners, there is a circular motif filled with a cross or X-shaped blue design, surrounded by smaller blue and off-white square patterns that repeat throughout the background. The entire drawing is bordered by a wide margin of off-white space, and the intricate blue patterns are constructed from a dense arrangement of small squares and tiny grids. The composition maintains symmetry, with the dominant blue motifs standing out against the lighter off-white background.
title: Coverlet
